family.description: This family of proteins are transient receptor potential (TRP) ion channels. They are essential for cellular viability and are involved in cell growth and cell wall synthesis [[cite:PUB00020495]]. The genes for these proteins are homologous to polycystic kidney disease related ion channel genes [[cite:PUB00020495]].
family.name: Transient receptor potential (TRP) ion channel
